name: Arbiter
senses: darkvision, detect alignment (chaotic only), locate inevitable

traits.name: Locate Inevitable
traits.text: An arbiter can always sense the direction of the nearest non-arbiter inevitable on the plane, but it cannot sense the range of the inevitable. Items shortsword.

traits.name: Electrical Burst
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, electricity, evocation); The arbiter releases an electrical burst from its body that deals 3d6 (3d6) electricity damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save). Following such a burst, the arbiter becomes stunned for 24 hours.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ shortsword +9 (agile, finesse, lawful, magical, versatile s); Damage 1d6+1 (1d6+1) piercing plus 1d4 (1d4) lawful
